## Loading Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("janitor")
library("patchwork")
library("broom")
library("curl")
library("here")
```

## Loading Augmented File

```{r}
brca <- read_csv(here("data", "brca_augment.csv"),
                     na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "?", "null"))
```

## Visualization

### Visualization 3 - Box plot + Jitter

```{r}
plot_df <- brca |>
  drop_na(integrative_cluster, mutation_count, mutation_burden_group) |>
  add_count(integrative_cluster) |>
  mutate(
    cluster_label = paste0(integrative_cluster, " (n = ", n, ")"),
    cluster_label = fct_reorder(cluster_label, mutation_count, .fun = median)
  )

vis_3 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(cluster_label, mutation_count)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = mutation_burden_group), width = 0.25, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, colour = "grey20", width = 0.55) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "white") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "Mutation burden", end = 0.9) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Mutation count by integrative cluster",
    subtitle = "Clusters ranked by median mutation count (diamond = median, log scale)",
    x = NULL, y = "Mutation count (log10 scale)"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
vis_3
```

Cluster 4ER+ and 6 have the lowest mutation count. Patient characteristics differ most in cluster 4ER- as the box is the biggest. The mutation counts of all the clusters are very similar so its not possible to determine which cluster is genomically unstable.

## Saving the Plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = here("results", "06_key_plot_3.png"),
       plot = vis_3, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
